record.category: Stremio addon (Arabic catalogs + private-tracker streams resolved through the user's own Real-Debrid or TorBox account)

free_tier.stated: Trial keys are issued by the Discord bot and are valid for 90 days; permanent keys are available to donors only and currently do not expire.
free_tier.notes: The byte volume is not the addon's: it is whatever the user's own debrid subscription allows.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the addon returns streams; the file size ceiling is the linked debrid account's.

retention.stated: not applicable: nothing is stored by the addon; cache retention is the debrid provider's.

egress.terms: Streams are played from the user's own Real-Debrid or TorBox account ('Streams are provided through your paid Real-Debrid or TorBox account'), so traffic is billed by that provider and not by Aradeb.

record.interface_detail: A Stremio addon endpoint configured at https://aradeb.518878.xyz; the Stremio client calls it over HTTP. Installation orders are distributed through the project's Discord.
record.tooling: Stremio desktop and mobile; a Discord bot for keys; no CLI and no API documentation beyond the addon protocol.
record.chaining: It is the Arabic-language layer on top of a global debrid subscription: the addon supplies Arabic catalogs and private-tracker sources, the debrid account supplies the bytes, and no regional service is bought.

limits.value: keys are issued by a Discord bot (90-day trials) and permanent access is donation-gated

record.limits_note: The listing warns the addon 'will not work properly unless it is installed correctly as explained in the Discord server', so the install channel is part of the access condition.
record.binding_note: No byte quota of its own exists; access is gated by a key that a human issues, and the key can expire while the debrid bill keeps running.

identity_cost.detail: A Discord account is required to reach the bot that issues keys; Discord signup itself takes an email. The addon has no separate registration.

record.reliability_note: Two dependencies must both hold: the debrid account's cache and the private trackers the addon queries. A trial key expires at 90 days, and permanent keys depend on a donation, so the addon can stop resolving for a user who is still paying a debrid subscription.
record.confidence_note: The feature list, the 90-day trial, the donor gating and the 4K claim were read on the addon's directory entry. What would raise it: an installed addon returning a playable stream.

evidence.proved: Arabic catalogs, Latin and Arabic search, streams 'provided through your paid Real-Debrid or TorBox account' up to 4K, 90-day trial keys via a Discord bot, permanent keys for donors only, configure page aradeb.518878.xyz

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 0 for the addon; the Real-Debrid or TorBox subscription is the cost
record.notes: This is the clearest evidence that the Arabic market consumes retrieval through a global service rather than a local one: the local layer is an addon, and the paid account is Real-Debrid or TorBox. A separate 'Arab debrid service' was searched for and not found (see findings.md).

record.category: addon directory for Stremio (curated list, HTML only)

free_tier.stated: The directory is free to browse with no account. /api/addons returns 404, so there is no machine-readable feed.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a directory of addon manifests

retention.stated: listings persist while the addon is maintained; the front page sorts by new, recently updated, top rising and popular

egress.terms: no byte allowance: the directory links to each addon's own manifest host

record.interface_detail: HTML only: /api/addons 404s and there is no documented JSON endpoint. The addon pages carry an install URL, which is the only machine-usable artefact.
record.tooling: A browser, or a scraper over the listing pages; the install URL per addon is a plain stremio:// or https manifest link that a client can consume directly.
record.chaining: Use it to enumerate candidate addons, then install the two or three that matter and let AIOStreams collapse them into one request per title.

limits.value: none published; the listing pages answered normally with no 429

record.limits_note: No API means no documented quota; the constraint is that enumeration is HTML parsing.
record.binding_note: Nothing here is metered and no rate was observed; the directory is a discovery surface, not a data source a client would poll.

identity_cost.detail: No account to read; saving favourites is the only feature the site ties to a sign-in.

record.reliability_note: The listing carries sponsored placements (TorrinSearch, NodStack) at the top, so ranking is partly paid and an entry's position is not a quality signal.
record.confidence_note: The home page and one sorted listing were read on 2026-10-23, and /api/addons was probed and 404d. A scrape of the full listing confirms how many entries it carries.

evidence.proved: 'Community curated Stremio addons list', new/recently updated/top rising/popular sections, and two sponsored placements above the fold
HTTP 404, so no JSON API is served at the obvious path

record.notes: Community addon directory for Stremio indexing streaming resolvers and debrid integrations.
